versions.changelog:
Initial release introducing ecosystem health auditing for skills.

- Scans skill directories for frontmatter validity, script syntax, staleness, near-duplicates (shingle Jaccard), and orphaned meta-skills.
- Outputs structured health reports to support meta-evolution engines in detecting repair/merge/drop candidates.
- Zero file side-effects; uses in-memory checks and avoids polluting file timestamps.
- Built-in self-test mode creates a temporary sandbox for safe validation.
- Customizable parameters for staleness period and duplicate similarity threshold.
